description: This file is a FastAPI backend implementation for a career pathway navigator application. It defines various API endpoints for health checks, role management, progress tracking, graph generation, recommendations, and assessments. The file imports modules for web handling, database models, repositories, and schemas, and contains the logic for constructing a role/skill graph, managing progress, and other core functionalities.

methods.name: None on_startup()
methods.description: Initializes the database and seeds a minimal dataset if necessary.

methods.name: dict health_check()
methods.description: Provides a health status message for the API.

methods.name: List[RoleOut] list_roles(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns a list of all available roles.

methods.name: RoleDetailOut get_role_detail(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific role, including skills and recommendations.

methods.name: List[ProgressOut] get_role_progress(role_name: str, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Lists progress entries for a given role.

methods.name: ProgressOut set_progress( role_name: str, skill_name: str = Query(..., min_length=2, max_length=200, description="Skill name"), status: str = Query(..., pattern="^(not_started|working_on|complete)$", description="Progress status"), current_level: int = Query(..., ge=0, le=5, description="Current skill level"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates or updates progress information for a role's skill.

methods.name: GraphOut get_graph( fromRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Current role ID"), toRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Target role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Constructs a graph suitable for visualization showing role relationships and skills.

methods.name: List[RecommendationOut] get_recommendations( roleId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Role ID"), skillId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Skill ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Fetches recommendations for a role-skill pair.

methods.name: AssessmentOut assess_roles(payload: AssessmentIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Compares required skills of current and target roles to identify strengths and gaps.

methods.name: Optional[Role] _get_role_by_id(repo: RoleRepository, role_id: int)
methods.description: Helper function to find a role by ID from the cached list.

methods.name: str _sanitize(value: str)
methods.description: Sanitizes string input to prevent control characters and whitespace issues.

ctags.name: assess_roles
ctags.pattern: /^def assess_roles(payload: AssessmentIn, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> AssessmentOut:$/

ctags.signature: ( fromRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Current role ID"), toRole: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Target role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.signature: ( roleId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Role ID"), skillId: int = Query(..., ge=1, description="Skill ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
